dialog.header-footer.title: Add Header and Footer
dialog.header-footer.note: printcraft marks_ui.rs body (HeaderFooter); Update and Bates numbering open the same dialog (Update replaces). Office-only Saved settings and Appearance Options are not in printcraft and are not shown; the Bates token is typed into a box (Bates numbering puts <<Bates Number#6#1##>> in the bottom-right one).

fields.label: Shrink the page content to make room for the header and footer

dialog.watermark.title: Add Watermark
dialog.watermark.note: printcraft marks_ui.rs body (Watermark). Source > File takes a PNG or JPEG picture from the picture picker (the bridge also takes a PDF page as base64). Office-only font, alignment, distances and show-when-printing are not in printcraft and are not shown.

dialog.background.title: Add Background
dialog.background.note: printcraft marks_ui.rs body (Background). Office-only rotation and distances are not in printcraft and are not shown.

edit.image.rotate-ccw.note: content_ui.rs: a quarter turn counterclockwise about the centre of the image as the page shows it (the placement matrix is turned; the pixels are not resampled).

edit.image.rotate-cw.note: A quarter turn clockwise about the centre of the image as the page shows it.

edit.image.flip-h.note: Mirrored left to right as the page shows it.

edit.image.flip-v.note: Mirrored top to bottom as the page shows it.

edit.image.replace.note: content_ui.rs: draws another picture (PNG or JPEG) in the same place, stretched to the old box (images.rs ImageChange::Replace). Grouped artwork cannot be replaced.

edit.image.crop.note: content_ui.rs: the percentage trimmed from each side (images.rs ImageChange::Crop): a clipping path inside the image's own scope, so a later move or resize carries it; the pixels are kept. Grouped artwork cannot be cropped.

edit.format.font.note: printcraft format_text_ui.rs: the font across the panel. Keep source fonts, the standard families (Helvetica, Times, Courier) and the fonts the page already uses (edit.format with the face, or edit.text_replace resource). Load font… and Installed fonts… (embedding a font file) are not translated and are not shown.

edit.format.size.note: Font size in points (a paragraph is rewritten at that size; its line spacing scales with it).

edit.format.colour.note: Text colour of the open paragraph (format_text_ui.rs colour_button).

edit.format.bold.note: Bold chooses the bold face of the paragraph's family (Helvetica-Bold, Times-Bold, Courier-Bold); the paragraph's own glyphs are not reused then (rewrite.rs source_font: reuse needs no family or bold choice).

edit.format.italic.note: Italic chooses the oblique face of the paragraph's family.

edit.format.underline.note: Underline each line of the open paragraph (rewrite.rs underline_ops: a line 0.06 em thick under the text, in its colour).

edit.format.line-spacing.note: Auto keeps the paragraph's own leading; a number is a multiple of the size (rewrite.rs line_lead: clamped to 0.5-5).

edit.format.align.label: Alignment
edit.format.align.note: format_text_ui.rs alignment: the whole paragraph (selected-row alignment of existing paragraphs is refused upstream too: rewrite.rs rewrite_block_from). Justify stretches every line but the last with word spacing.

edit.image_change.note: Translated from printcraft 8f16855 crates/edit/src/images.rs (page_images, change_image: transform folded into the `q cm Do Q` the image sits in, crop as a clip in its own scope, delete) and ui-egui tools/content_ui.rs. NOT translated: the path-clip hit test (an image is hit by its whole box), images inside form XObjects and inline images (not listed), a Form's crop, image_transform_scope's search of outer scopes for an image under a shared clip.

edit.image_replace.note: ImageChange::Replace: the other picture is drawn by `Do` in the same place and stretched to the old box (upstream does not fit it). PNG and JPEG only here (the picture is embedded with pdf-lib).

edit.images.note: page_images, for the surface: the page's own images and artwork, not the headers, footers, watermarks and backgrounds this app added.

edit.edit_text.note: Translated from printcraft 8f16855 (crates/edit/src/text/{interp,lines,blocks,rewrite,fallback}.rs, text_regions/grouping.rs, crates/fonts/src/pdf.rs, ui-egui edit_text_ui.rs and format_text_ui.rs) into core/folio/lib/text-*.mjs. Paragraphs are the page's text runs joined on baselines (interpreter), rows and blocks (grouping), written back as a new content stream (rewrite); the page's other streams are untouched. NOT translated, and said so where it matters: (1) the styled path is translated in part (see the end of this note); (2) Type 3 / Japanese / Hebrew fallback faces, bidi and Indic reordering, vertical writing: text in those is listed as not editable with the reason, never rewritten wrongly; (3) text drawn by form XObjects is not listed (upstream lists it for reading only); an operator split between two content streams is not read; (4) the embedded font program is not read: a subset font is taken to have a glyph where /Widths or /W lists one, and a character it lacks is set in Helvetica, Times or Courier with a notice (never a wrong glyph); embedding a font file (Load font…, Installed fonts…) is not translated; (5) source_space searches only the paragraph's own font for a space width (0.33 em otherwise); (6) selected-row alignment of an existing paragraph is refused, as upstream refuses it; (7) the lists, superscript, subscript and paragraph spacing controls are shown disabled, as upstream shows them ("planned"). Nothing in the document is executed: its content is only parsed (JavaScript actions are never run). Reading and rewriting are async (needs: worker) and read the page in slices of 20,000 operators with the event loop in between, so a large page does not freeze the window; they run on the session's thread, not in electron/format-worker.cjs (which has no folio text operation; the pdfium inspect_pdf_text and replace_pdf_text of the earlier path stay as they were: upstream does not use pdfium, so none of it is reused). Dragging a paragraph box moves it (translate_blocks) and typing rewrites it. Add link and Attach file (content_ui.rs) are not translated yet: their controls stay marked as not translated. Styled path: a paragraph of several fonts, sizes or colours keeps each run's style when its words change (core/folio/lib/text-styled.mjs: edited_spans aligns the old and new words so untouched words keep their runs, inserted text takes the run before it; a character its run's font lacks is shown in the run's standard family). NOT translated: formatting a selected part of a paragraph (BlockStyle.ranges), shaping and fallback faces, the /P marker bookkeeping, runs drawn at different scales or turned (set in the first run's style). Reading and rewriting run in a folio worker of its own (src/workers/folio-text.ts, core/folio/lib/text-ops.mjs) and, when no worker can start, in the calling thread in slices. Images, added items and the other commands still run on the session's thread. The rewrap handles on a paragraph's left and right edges are in the page view (edit_text_ui.rs Grip::Left and Grip::Right: upright pages only), and the open box shows a blinking caret.

edit.text_replace.note: Edit::EditTextBlock (rewrite_block): the paragraph is rewrapped to its own width and keeps its font when that font can show every character; Helvetica, Times or Courier stand in otherwise and `notice` says so. See edit.edit_text for what is not translated.

edit.text_move.note: Edit::MoveObjects for text (translate_blocks): each show operator moves by a TJ offset and the text rise, restored after it, so glyphs, fonts, breaks and the text after it are untouched.

edit.format.note: format_text_ui.rs: Font (Keep source fonts, Helvetica, Times, Courier, or a face the page uses), size, colour, alignment, bold, italic, underline, line spacing, horizontal scale, character spacing; each choice rewrites the open paragraph at once (BlockStyle).

edit.background.note: Checked against printcraft 8f16855: the Background gained a default of light yellow (1, 0.95, 0.7), which is followed, and replace_backdrop (backdrop.rs: a white backdrop the page paints itself is replaced so the background shows through). The backdrop replacement is not translated: a page that paints its own white page fill hides the background here.
